description: Invite someone into the organization by email, with a role: owner (admin), manager, member or viewer. An invite grants access to the organization's data at that role once accepted. The result says whether the invite email was queued; when it was not (no email configured, delivery failure) the invite still exists, and its link can be shared from the app's Members page. A live pending invite for the same address is refused (invitePending), so a repeated call never duplicates. Admin only.

role.description: Role in the organization — owner is the admin role

name: create_invite

emailQueued.description: True = the invite email was handed to the provider

note.description: Present when no email went out — share the link from the app

title: Invite member
